S50U26.five_day_thesis: Over the five sessions to 2026-07-28 the future fell 12.8 points (1096.6 to 1083.8, -1.2%) while ATM IV rose 1.29 points (13.72% to 15.01%, +9.4%) - price down and vol up together is protection demand, not an unwind. The near put wall migrated 30 points up, from 1050 (1,164 OI) to 1080 (1,312 OI), so the level the book defends climbed to meet a falling future rather than the future falling to the wall. The gamma flip drifted from 1100 to ~1,105 as the 1100 call strike added 322 contracts (+22.9%), leaving spot 21.6 points under the level where dealers turn long gamma. The 25-delta skew flipped from +1.02 to -0.73 while the 10-delta skew stayed positive at +2.51 - the tail is still put-rich, but the 25-delta collar zone has been bid on the call side. Max pain has not left 1060 in six of seven sessions, which at 63 DTE makes it a slow anchor rather than a magnet.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1080/1040
strategies.rationale: 63 DTE Protection zone plus short dealer gamma below the ~1,105 flip maps to defined-risk downside insurance rather than premium selling; the long leg sits on the live 1080 put wall (1,312 OI, 596 lots traded) and the short leg on the 25-delta put band at 1040.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 13.1 points net debit (24.35 - 11.25 at mids) = 2,620 baht per spread at 200 baht/point; max gain 26.9 points; breakeven 1066.9.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above the 1,731-contract 1100 call wall with call volume expanding.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1040/1000
strategies.rationale: Targets the 1000-1050 strip carrying the chain's most negative per-strike GEX, where a break under the 1060 shelf forces dealers to sell into weakness; the strikes sit exactly on the 25-delta (1040) and 10-delta (1000) put bands.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 5.55 points net debit (11.25 - 5.70 at mids) = 1,110 baht per spread; max gain 34.45 points; breakeven 1034.45.
strategies.invalidation: A close above the 1110 flip strike, which turns dealers long gamma and removes the amplification this structure relies on.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1120/1140
strategies.rationale: Above the ~1,105 flip dealers turn long gamma and fade rallies, so the 1120 (25-delta call) / 1140 shelf is where a defined-risk short-vol lego has structural backing - sized small, because 15.01% IV is expanding rather than compressed and short-vol payoff is negative-skew.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point width - 5.00-point credit = 15.0 points = 3,000 baht per spread; max gain 5.0 points; breakeven 1125.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1120 with ATM IV extending beyond 15.5% - flow beating the long-gamma shelf.

S50U26.prediction: 1060-1110 is the structural range: 1,731 contracts of call OI at 1100 plus the ~1,105 gamma flip cap rallies, while 1060 - max pain, 1,401 call and 1,033 put OI - is the shelf sitting above the negative-GEX strip. Base case is drift inside that band with a downside tilt, since spot sits 23.8 points above max pain and dealer hedging amplifies below the flip. A close above 1110 with call volume and IV both expanding invalidates the bearish tilt; a close below 1060 on rising put volume opens 1040 and then the 1000-1030 negative-GEX pocket.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - nothing here is advice to execute a trade, and defined risk is not risk-free: the capped max loss is a real loss. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical share delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks - treat max pain 1060 and the ~1,105 gamma flip as tendencies, not guarantees. This chain is the 2026-07-28 session re-marked by the 2026-07-30 00:17 scrape rather than a new session, so OI and volume are two sessions stale and macro flow can override the option structure outright before the next print lands.
